Phases: (phase)
- 100% hp: Only use swipes.
- 75% hp: Ent roars, use slams/fling too. Start phase with jumping slam.
- 50% hp: Ent roars, start using root attacks.

Attacks:
- Left arm swipe (1, 2, 3)
- Right arm swipe (1, 2, 3)
- Slam (2, 3)
- Jumping slam (2, 3)
- Fling (2, 3)
- Root burst (3)
- Root target (3)

Combos:
- Left swipe > right swipe (1, 2, 3)
- Left swipe > right swipe > slam (2, 3)
- Fling > jumping slam (2, 3)
- Fling > root burst (3)
- Root target > jumping slam (3)
- Root target > root burst (3)
